problem:
Problem description
- A staffing plan is required for a university computer lab over a planning horizon of $$T$$ days indexed by $$\mathcal{T}=\{1,2,\ldots,T\}$$.
- There is a set of students indexed by $$\mathcal{I}=\{1,2,\ldots,N\}$$, partitioned into undergraduates $$\mathcal{U}$$ and graduate students $$\mathcal{G}$$.
- Each student $$i\in\mathcal{I}$$ has an hourly wage $$w_i$$ and a day-specific maximum assignable duty time $$a_{it}$$ for each day $$t\in\mathcal{T}$$.
- The lab has an operating window on each day $$t$$, described by an opening time $$\tau_t^{\mathrm{open}}$$ and a closing time $$\tau_t^{\mathrm{close}}$$, and the lab must be continuously covered throughout that operating window.
- The planning goal is to choose which students work on which days, how long they work, and the detailed daily duty ordering if needed, so that all coverage requirements are satisfied and total gross pay is minimized.
- Required business constraints:
  - The lab must have exactly one student on duty at every moment during each operating window.
  - No more than $$m^{\max}$$ students may be scheduled on any single day.
  - Each student may work at most $$s^{\max}$$ shifts per week.
  - Each undergraduate student must accumulate at least $$L^{\mathrm{U}}$$ working hours in the week.
  - Each graduate student must accumulate at least $$L^{\mathrm{G}}$$ working hours in the week.
  - The duty hours assigned to student $$i$$ on day $$t$$ must not exceed that student’s daily availability $$a_{it}$$.
  - All assigned duty must lie within the operating window of the corresponding day.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_{it}$$: a binary assignment indicator showing whether student $$i$$ is scheduled on day $$t$$.
  - $$h_{it}$$: the number of duty hours assigned to student $$i$$ on day $$t$$.
  - $$s_{it}$$ and $$e_{it}$$: the start and end times of student $$i$$’s duty block on day $$t$$, if a detailed intra-day schedule is required.
  - $$H_i$$: the total weekly hours assigned to student $$i$$.
  - $$R_i$$: the total number of shifts assigned to student $$i$$.

Input Format
{
  "student_index_set": "$$\\mathcal{I}=\\{1,2,\\ldots,N\\}$$",
  "undergraduate_subset": "$$\\mathcal{U}\\subseteq\\mathcal{I}$$",
  "graduate_subset": "$$\\mathcal{G}\\subseteq\\mathcal{I}$$",
  "day_index_set": "$$\\mathcal{T}=\\{1,2,\ldots,T\\}$$",
  "days": "An ordered list of the $$T$$ planning days",
  "operating_window": {
    "open_time": "$$\\tau_t^{\\mathrm{open}}$$ for each $$t\\in\\mathcal{T}$$",
    "close_time": "$$\\tau_t^{\\mathrm{close}}$$ for each $$t\\in\\mathcal{T}$$",
    "coverage_rule": "Continuous coverage by exactly one student during each operating window"
  },
  "student_data": {
    "shape": "One record per student $$i\\in\\mathcal{I}$$",
    "fields": {
      "id": "Student index $$i$$",
      "category": "Either undergraduate or graduate",
      "wage": "$$w_i$$",
      "daily_max_hours": "The vector $$\\{a_{it}: t\\in\\mathcal{T}\\}$$"
    }
  },
  "wage_vector": "$$w\\in\\mathbb{R}_+^{N}$$ with entries $$w_i$$",
  "availability_matrix": "$$A\\in\\mathbb{R}_+^{N\\times T}$$ with entries $$A_{it}=a_{it}$$",
  "student_category_vector": "$$g\\in\\{\\mathrm{U},\\mathrm{G}\\}^{N}$$",
  "minimum_weekly_hours": {
    "undergraduate": "$$L^{\\mathrm{U}}$$",
    "graduate": "$$L^{\\mathrm{G}}$$"
  },
  "max_shifts_per_week": "$$s^{\\max}$$",
  "max_students_per_day": "$$m^{\\max}$$",
  "coverage_hours": "$$q_t$$ for each $$t\\in\\mathcal{T}$$, where $$q_t$$ is the total required open-hours coverage on day $$t$$",
  "objective": "Minimize total gross pay"
}

Output Format
{
  "objective_value": "The minimum total gross pay attained by the schedule",
  "schedule_by_day": [
    {
      "day": "$$t\\in\\mathcal{T}$$",
      "duty_blocks": [
        {
          "block_index": "$$k$$",
          "student_id": "$$i\\in\\mathcal{I}$$",
          "start_time": "$$s_{tk}$$",
          "end_time": "$$e_{tk}$$",
          "hours": "$$h_{ik}$$"
        }
      ],
      "number_of_scheduled_students": "$$\\le m^{\\max}$$"
    }
  ],
  "student_summary": [
    {
      "student_id": "$$i\\in\\mathcal{I}$$",
      "weekly_hours": "$$H_i$$",
      "shift_count": "$$R_i$$",
      "gross_pay": "$$w_i\\cdot H_i$$"
    }
  ]
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "days": ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"],
  "operating_window": {
    "open_time": "08:00",
    "close_time": "22:00",
    "coverage_rule": "Continuous coverage by exactly one student during each operating window"
  },
  "student_data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "category": "undergraduate",
      "wage": 10.0,
      "daily_max_hours": [6, 0, 6, 0, 7]
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "category": "undergraduate",
      "wage": 10.0,
      "daily_max_hours": [0, 8, 9, 6, 0]
    },
    {
      "id": 3,
      "category": "undergraduate",
      "wage": 9.9,
      "daily_max_hours": [4, 8, 3, 0, 5]
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "category": "undergraduate",
      "wage": 9.8,
      "daily_max_hours": [5, 5, 6, 0, 4]
    },
    {
      "id": 5,
      "category": "graduate",
      "wage": 10.8,
      "daily_max_hours": [3, 0, 5, 8, 0]
    },
    {
      "id": 6,
      "category": "graduate",
      "wage": 11.3,
      "daily_max_hours": [0, 6, 0, 6, 5]
    }
  ],
  "minimum_weekly_hours": {
    "undergraduate": 8,

  },

parameters.name: undergraduate_subset
parameters.description: subset of students classified as undergraduates

parameters.name: graduate_subset
parameters.description: subset of students classified as graduates

parameters.name: daily_max_duty_hours
parameters.description: maximum assignable duty hours for student i on day t

parameters.name: max_students_per_day
parameters.description: maximum number of students scheduled on any single day

parameters.name: max_shifts_per_week
parameters.description: maximum shifts per student per week

parameters.name: min_weekly_hours_undergraduate
parameters.description: minimum weekly hours required for each undergraduate student

parameters.name: min_weekly_hours_graduate
parameters.description: minimum weekly hours required for each graduate student

parameters.name: daily_coverage_hours
parameters.description: required total open-hours coverage on each day

parameters.name: student_category
parameters.description: category indicator for each student, undergraduate or graduate

variables.name: assignment_indicator
variables.description: binary assignment indicator equal to 1 if student i is scheduled on day t

variables.name: daily_duty_hours
variables.description: duty hours assigned to student i on day t

variables.name: duty_start_time
variables.description: start time of student i's duty block on day t

variables.name: duty_end_time
variables.description: end time of student i's duty block on day t

variables.name: weekly_hours_assigned
variables.description: total weekly hours assigned to student i

variables.name: weekly_shift_count
variables.description: total number of shifts assigned to student i

auxiliary_variables.name: daily_coverage_indicator
auxiliary_variables.description: binary indicator used to model whether student i covers day t in the continuous coverage formulation

auxiliary_variables.name: student_order_indicator
auxiliary_variables.description: binary ordering variable indicating whether student i is scheduled before student j on day t

auxiliary_variables.name: coverage_point_indicator
auxiliary_variables.description: binary indicator for whether a coverage segment starts at a discretized point on day t

auxiliary_variables.name: shift_link_indicator
auxiliary_variables.description: binary indicator equal to 1 if student i is assigned to work on day t

constraints.name: student_category_partition
constraints.description: Undergraduate and graduate sets form a partition of all students

constraints.name: wage_nonnegative
constraints.description: Hourly wages must be nonnegative

constraints.name: availability_nonnegative
constraints.description: Daily maximum assignable duty hours must be nonnegative

constraints.name: open_close_validity
constraints.description: Daily opening time must be no later than daily closing time

constraints.name: coverage_requirement
constraints.description: Continuous one-student coverage is enforced through daily assignment and non-overlap of assigned duty blocks over the operating window

constraints.name: max_students_per_day
constraints.description: No more than the maximum number of students may be scheduled on any day

constraints.name: max_shifts_per_week
constraints.description: Each student may work at most the allowed number of shifts per week

constraints.name: minimum_weekly_hours_undergraduate
constraints.description: Each undergraduate student must accumulate at least the required minimum weekly hours

constraints.name: minimum_weekly_hours_graduate
constraints.description: Each graduate student must accumulate at least the required minimum weekly hours

constraints.name: daily_duty_within_availability
constraints.description: Assigned duty hours for each student-day pair cannot exceed the student's availability on that day

constraints.name: duty_within_operating_window
constraints.description: All assigned duty for each day must lie within the daily operating window

constraints.name: one_student_at_a_time
constraints.description: Assigned duty blocks do not overlap on the same day
constraints.formula: s_{it} \ge e_{jt} - M(1-z_{ijt}) \;\; \forall i,j\in\mathcal{I}, i<j, \forall t\in\mathcal{T};\; z_{ijt}+z_{jit}=1

constraints.name: variable_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Assigned hours and summary totals must be nonnegative

constraints.name: binary_assignment_domain
constraints.description: Assignment indicators must be binary

constraints.name: weekly_hours_definition
constraints.description: Weekly hours are the sum of daily duty hours across the planning horizon

constraints.name: weekly_shift_count_definition
constraints.description: Weekly shift count is the sum of daily assignment indicators across the planning horizon

constraints.name: daily_duty_duration_definition
constraints.description: Daily duty hours equal duty end time minus duty start time for each student-day assignment

constraints.name: assignment_implies_positive_hours
constraints.description: If a student is not assigned on a day, then their daily duty hours must be zero; if assigned, hours are bounded by availability

constraints.name: duty_start_end_bounds
constraints.description: Duty start and end times must lie within the operating window whenever a student is assigned
constraints.formula: \tau_t^{\mathrm{open}} x_{it} \le s_{it} \le e_{it} \le \tau_t^{\mathrm{close}} x_{it} + \tau_t^{\mathrm{close}}(1-x_{it}) \quad \forall i\in\mathcal{I},\forall t\in\mathcal{T}

constraints.name: binary_assignment_link
constraints.description: Assignment indicators and auxiliary shift-link indicators are identical

objectives.name: minimize_total_gross_pay
objectives.description: Minimize total gross pay across all students, measured by the sum of each student's hourly wage times weekly assigned hours

final_objective.description: Minimize total gross pay across all students, measured by the sum of each student's hourly wage times weekly assigned hours.
